alkylation_reagent: FASP procedure included the following steps: SDS buffer replacement with 8M urea buffer, protein alkylation with iodoacetamide and replacement of urea buffer with 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate.
cleavage_agent: Sequencing grade trypsin was then added to the samples at a ratio of 1:50 (μg trypsin: μg protein) and incubated overnight at 37 °C.
fractionation_method: We fractionated the peptides of each of the samples into six fractions by strong anion exchange chromatography in a StageTip format as described previously.
fragmentation_method: Higher energy collisional dissociation fragmentation was performed for the top-10 peaks in each MS scan.
instrument: HPLC was coupled online via a nano-electrospray ion source to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).

MS/MS spectra were searched in the Andromeda search engine against the forward and reverse Human Uniprot database including the variable modifications methionine oxidation and N-terminal acetylation, and the fixed modification of carbamidomethyl cysteine.
reduction_concentration: Samples were deparaffinized with two 5 min incubations in xylene, followed by two 5 min incubations with absolute ethanol. After removal of ethanol, samples were vacuum-dried and resuspended in lysis buffer containing 100 mM Tris HCl pH 7.5, 4% SDS and 100 mM DTT.
